title: curated severity/progression literature pass, round 5 (PMC-OA dominant-sequela join) — three honest S/P lifts that add no new order-lock

litcurate5_join.exact_sentence: Maple syrup urine disease (MSUD, OMIM # 248600 ) is a life-threatening metabolic disorder caused by biallelic pathogenic variants in the BCKDHA , BCKDHB, DBT , and DLD genes, which encode the E1α, E1β, E2 and E3 subunits (respectively) of the branched-chain amino acid (BCKD) enzyme complex [ 11 , 12 ].

Cystic fibrosis (CF) is a progressive genetic disease characterized by defective ion transport, mucus accumulation, chronic infection, and inflammation that drive airway damage and ultimately end-stage lung failure.
Pompe disease is a rare neuromuscular disorder caused by acid alpha-glucosidase deficiency, leading to glycogen accumulation and progressive striated muscle weakness.

litcurate5_excluded.considered_statement: Severe osteogenesis imperfecta is often diagnosed earlier than milder disease.
litcurate5_excluded.exclusion_reason: the retrievable OA disease-level severity framing for osteogenesis imperfecta (C0029434) is COMPARATIVE -- 'Severe osteogenesis imperfecta is often diagnosed earlier than milder disease' uses 'severe' as the phenotype-class label distinguishing severe OI (Sillence type III / perinatally-lethal type II) from milder OI (type I), not a clean disease-level magnitude for the umbrella entity's own dominant untreated sequela (heritable bone fragility / recurrent fractures); OI severity is Sillence-type-stratified across a mild-to-perinatally-lethal range, so although the frozen R3 severity function pattern-matches 'severe' to tier 0.75, the word is a within-entity phenotype-class label rather than an isolable disease-level magnitude; S left [H], not lifted

litcurate5_excluded.considered_statement: Clinical presentation can vary widely in severity from resulting in stillbirth to being asymptomatic, correlating with the number of functional alpha globin genes inherited.
litcurate5_excluded.exclusion_reason: the retrievable OA severity framing for the alpha-thalassemia umbrella entity (C0002312) is an UMBRELLA SPECTRUM -- 'Clinical presentation can vary widely in severity from resulting in stillbirth to being asymptomatic, correlating with the number of functional alpha globin genes inherited' -- gene-dosage-stratified from asymptomatic (silent carrier / one affected gene) through HbH disease to fatal Hb Bart's hydrops fetalis (stillbirth, all four genes); the disease-level magnitude is genotype-stratified across the asymptomatic-to-lethal continuum, so a clean disease-level magnitude for the umbrella entity's own single dominant sequela is not isolable; the frozen R3 spectrum override trips on this within-entity range; S left [H], not lifted
